# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c22 P4](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is an attractive young woman with light curly hair, captivating eyes, and a very gentle spoken tone. She dresses in a gorgeous, extremely stylish manner, boasting the puffiest sleeves in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and open-minded teacher who possesses the talent to capture her students' love while drawing out their best intellectual and moral qualities. She is tactile and gentle, correcting her pupils through earnest discussions rather than harsh punishments or physical discipline. Though strict when a student acts dishonestly or misuses time, she is quick to grant forgiveness when met with genuine remorse.

_Sources: [v1 c20 P31](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0031), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired to take over the Brierley school, becoming the first female teacher ever employed in the village. Her appointment was initially met with skepticism by some locals who disapproved of her innovative methods, such as holding bi-weekly recitation afternoons, conducting field days in the forest to study nature, and leading daily physical culture exercises. Despite these criticisms, she quickly earned the deep love and admiration of her pupils, including Nell Harcourt.

In November, Miss Thorne organized a Christmas concert to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag, guiding her students through weeks of enthusiastic rehearsals. Later in the school year, when Nell was terrified of ghost stories she had invented about the nearby spruce wood, Miss Thorne firmly forced her to walk through the grove at dusk to break her belief in her own daydreams. To help her advanced students prepare for the Regent’s entrance exam, she formed a special after-school study class. Although offered a position at a grade school in her home district, Miss Thorne chose to remain at Brierley to guide her students through their final preparation year. When Nell fell behind in geometry and hid a novel inside her desk during history class, Miss Thorne gently confronted her about her academic dishonesty, prompting Nell to promise strict adherence to her studies. She resigned from Brierley school after successfully guiding her students through the Regent's Entrance examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c20 P30](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0030), [v1 c20 P33](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0033), [v1 c22 P4](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0004), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_
